name: Triple-Stack Enforcement Foundation
description: Manifest declares the full triple enforcement stack on one child device: BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE + BIND_VPN_SERVICE + BIND_DEVICE_ADMIN, plus a permanent foreground service and a NotificationListener keep-alive anchor.
behavior_summary: Declares DeviceAdmin + AccessibilityService + VpnService + QustodioService(systemExempted) + RestartServiceNotification in one 307-line manifest.

reusability_assessment.notes: Component topology to mirror; replace hacks with Device Owner where available.

name: DeviceAdmin Anti-Uninstall Anchor
description: DeviceAdminReceiver used purely as an anti-uninstall anchor: the OS blocks uninstall while admin is active; onDisableRequested shows a parental warning only when the device is paired (IS_ACCOUNT_CONFIGURED). Zero policies, zero DevicePolicyManager calls.
behavior_summary: Stub receiver: onDisableRequested returns warning strings (device_admin_disable_warning{,2}) iff prefs i()==IS_ACCOUNT_CONFIGURED; onEnabled/onDisabled only log; onPasswordChanged empty.

reusability_assessment.notes: Replace with DevicePolicyManager.setUninstallBlocked under Device Owner.

name: Accessibility Event Pipeline
description: Two-layer accessibility service: a generic library (parcel-cloned events, single-flight coroutine processing, 29-parser registry) plus the kid-app subclass with tamper/block handlers.
behavior_summary: onAccessibilityEvent clones each event via Parcel, buffers in a synchronized list, processes sequentially on one coroutine; R3.c registry builds parsers per enabled H3.e features; K3.a(type,data,time) events dispatched by category.

reusability_assessment.notes: Parcel-clone + single-flight pattern is directly reusable.

name: UninstallLongClickParser + Password Gate
description: Anti-uninstall via accessibility: detects long-click on the app icon (Samsung launcher label or any view text matching the brand via X3.a) and MIUI uninstall dialogs by view-IDs, then opens the parental password gate.
behavior_summary: On TYPE_VIEW_LONG_CLICKED: read source text (or com.sec.android.app.launcher:id/label); match brand name via X3.a (not EditText); on com.miui.home: miui:id/parentPanel -> uninstall_dialog -> title. Emit UNINSTALL_LONG_CLICK; handler starts SettingsPasswordRequestActivity (NEW_TASK on SDK>26, PendingIntent below); 500ms dedupe in t0().

reusability_assessment.notes: Best non-Device-Owner uninstall defence seen; superseded by setUninstallBlocked under DO.

name: Tamper-Defence Parser Battery
description: Remaining tamper parsers: Settings, SplitScreen, PopUpView (generic/Samsung+14/Xiaomi), NotificationOverlay/ServicePanel, SamsungAppsEdge, PipScreen, DualApps — with gesture/back/home counter-responses.
behavior_summary: Settings tampering -> password gate + double-back + re-evaluate block; split/PiP -> performToggleSplit + dispatchGesture swipe + PipBlockerActivity; notification panel tampering detected separately.

reusability_assessment.notes: OEM coverage list is the reusable asset.

name: 7-Decision Blocker Engine
description: Prioritized blocking decision table: CLOSE_POPUP_VIEWS > BLOCK_DRAW_OVERLAY_SETTINGS > LOCK_SETTINGS > LOCK_DEVICE > BLOCKED_APP > DEVICE_TIME_OUT > APP_TIME_OUT, executed via WindowManager overlay (TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY) or BlockerActivity.
behavior_summary: p224v4.c.p(foregroundApp, allApps)/q(...) evaluate in fixed priority and return p224v4.a; OverlayBlocker adds a MATCH_PARENT TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY (2038) view with countdown timer; includes anti-tamper rule blocking the overlay-permission settings screen.

reusability_assessment.notes: Adopt the 7-decision priority table verbatim as the child-agent decision contract.

name: QProxy Native VPN Stack
description: Full native HTTP(S) proxy engine: Kotlin VpnService -> JNA VpnCLib -> JNI libvpn-lib -> libqproxy.so (QProxyServer/Worker, HTTP/1+HTTP/2, TLS MITM, embedded block page, search-query regexes, OpenSSL 1.1.1m static, shared with desktop builds).
behavior_summary: HttpVpnService builds tun 10.1.10.1/32 + setHttpProxy(127.0.0.1:port) + addAllowedApplication per app; JNI init/start/stopQProxy + qProxy*Action callbacks; native handles sessions, cert generation, block/allow/defer verdicts; config JSON includes *.whatsapp.net->BAD_REQUEST_THEN_CLOSE; UA QustodioProxy/4.7.4.

reusability_assessment.notes: Do NOT copy the binary; reimplement the callback protocol on an open engine.

name: TLS MITM Certificate Install Flow
description: User CA install flow for TLS interception: KeyChain.createInstallIntent with the DER cert, plus installed-state detection; VPN setup start/stop via explicit intents.
behavior_summary: W7.c.f(activity): if not installed -> KeyChain.createInstallIntent() with name+CERT bytes; HttpEventDetectionSetup.isCertificateInstalled(); g()/h() start/stop HttpVpnService via com.qustodio.vpn.HttpVpnService.start|stop intents; X7.b{certificate,certificatePrivateKey,clientKey} fed to initQProxy.

reusability_assessment.notes: Under Device Owner replace with silent installCaCert.

name: Signed Command Interpreter (FCM)
description: FCM data-message command channel: FirebaseMessagingService -> HandlePushDataMessageJob -> MessageV1Interpreter with 7 named actions. The 'signature' field exists but is NOT cryptographically verified client-side.
behavior_summary: Actions: update_location/update_policy/update_settings/update_application/enable_logging(604800s default)/upload_logs/disable_panic_mode; extras keys 'message'/'signature'; s() only checks non-empty; no HMAC anywhere.

reusability_assessment.notes: Reuse the 7-action vocabulary; ADD real HMAC-SHA256 verification (their gap).

name: Rule Contract Models
description: Explicit rule data models: ApplicationRules with per-day quotas, TimeRestrictions with Day windows and 6 flags, plus Browser/SocialMonitoring/Contact/Location/PanicButton/SafeNetwork rules.

reusability_assessment.notes: Adopt as the quota/schedule data model; cleaner than FamiSafe string encoding.

name: Keep-Alive Package
description: Multi-layer process survival: permanent foreground service (START_STICKY, systemExempted), empty NotificationListenerService anchor, boot receiver with wasForceStopped() check, persistent=true, dynamic connectivity/screen receivers, user-switch tracking.
behavior_summary: QustodioService.onCreate startForeground(12648430); DeviceBootReceiver restarts on BOOT_COMPLETED/MY_PACKAGE_REPLACED unless wasForceStopped() (API35+); RestartServiceNotification is a 7-line stub; UserSwitchReceiver tracks USER_FOREGROUND/BACKGROUND.

reusability_assessment.notes: Reference for agent resilience; verify systemExempted/persistent grants.

name: SMS/Call Monitoring
description: Max-priority SMS/call receivers feeding a central comms monitor: SmsOnReceived parses PDUs via p254y4.a into address->body and forwards to p234w4.b; CallOnProcess handles PHONE_STATE/NEW_OUTGOING_CALL.
behavior_summary: SmsOnReceived (exported, priority 2147483647, 5 SMS/MMS filters) processes SMS_RECEIVED only -> d(bundle) -> p254y4.a PDU parse -> p234w4.b.I(address,body); CallOnProcess mirrors for calls.

reusability_assessment.notes: SMS/call content monitoring is policy-sensitive; confirm Family OS scope.

name: Social Chat Scrapers (6 platforms)
description: Accessibility-based chat text scrapers for WhatsApp, Instagram, Line, TikTok, Snapchat, TwitterX, built on an abstract SocialMonitoringParser with selective enablement.
behavior_summary: SocialMonitoringParser extends R3.a (abstract A/E/H/J/N hooks); per-platform *ChatParser registered in R3.c; enabled/disabled via S3.a b(socialPlatforms)/d().

reusability_assessment.notes: Fragile (per-app view-IDs); use as secondary layer behind server-side intelligence.

name: YouTube Monitoring
description: YouTube watch/search monitoring via accessibility: app parser scrapes video title/channel view-IDs; browser parsers cover web YouTube in Chrome/Firefox.
behavior_summary: YoutubeAppParser reads com.google.android.youtube:id/title|channel|channel_title; YoutubeChromeParser/YoutubeFirefoxParser for web; emits YOUTUBE_SEARCH_APP/YOUTUBE_WATCH_VIDEO_APP/YOUTUBE_WATCH_VIDEO_WEB.

reusability_assessment.notes: Same fragility caveat as social scrapers.

name: Browser URL Parsers + Native Search Regexes
description: Dual web-visibility: accessibility URL-bar scrapers for 5 browsers plus native search-query regexes (Google/Bing/DuckDuckGo/Yahoo/Lycos/Yandex) embedded in libqproxy.
behavior_summary: ChromeParser: com.android.chrome:id/url_bar|origin (Firefox/Samsung/Huawei/Silk analogous); GoogleSearchParser; native regexes extract q=/p=/text= params from search URLs for safe-search monitoring.

reusability_assessment.notes: Complements VPN filtering; native regex list is a ready safe-search spec.

name: Location Reporting Stack
description: Layered location stack: reportCurrentLocation use-case (Y4.a) over a location repository (X4.a) backed by FusedLocationProviderClient (V4.a) + Geocoder; triggered by update_location push.
behavior_summary: Y4.a(X4.a locationRepository) emits W4.b via Flow; V4.a provides FusedLocationProviderClient + Geocoder; FINE_LOCATION declared; intervals obfuscated (Partial).

reusability_assessment.notes: Pattern is standard; cadence policy needs runtime confirmation.

name: Panic Mode (Headset Trigger)
description: Panic trigger via headset plug/unplug and wired-headset media button (keycodes 126/79 on ACTION_UP), driving a panic engine with alert worker and trusted-contacts UI.
behavior_summary: PanicButtonEventReceiver: HEADSET_PLUG state 1->e()/0->h(); MEDIA_BUTTON keycode 126/79 ACTION_UP->d(keyEvent); engine p225v5.a; PanicModeAlertsWorker; activities PanicButton/TrustedContacts/EmergencyCalls.

reusability_assessment.notes: Unconventional hardware panic button; evaluate as differentiator.

name: Encrypted Remote Config (qinit)
description: Remote configuration bundles shipped as encrypted binary JSON in assets/qinit/ (common, mobile, parents_app, sharedCommon, sso, marketing).
behavior_summary: assets/qinit/*.json are non-plaintext binary blobs; API hosts are not statically visible anywhere (Partial).

reusability_assessment.notes: Family OS should prefer signed plaintext config over obscurity.

name: Reporting Pipeline
description: Event reporting: typed event models (application/smscall/web/youtube), auto-reporting (ConfigDeviceReporter), feature-state reporting (DeviceOptionsReporter + FeaturesStateReportWorker), daily sync worker.

reusability_assessment.notes: Event taxonomy is a good starting spec for Family OS telemetry.
